99:t_2:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「If you had granted me just a little more time, I could have accomplished my objective...」

99:t_2:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sorry to have gotten in your way. As the one entrusted with all of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces, I too wanted to give my all to carrying out the mission.」

99:t_2:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Supreme Commander $$ハマーン$$... Please tell me what you intended by trying to bring in $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

99:t_2:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They had their own intel network and connections in the $$ＡＤＷ$$. For these two months... they used them to keep throwing us into disarray, despite their small force...」

99:t_2:10.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You chose to win them over rather than defeat them?」

99:t_2:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Exactly. Realizing their ideal of eradicating war is what $$ネオ・ジオン$$ wants as well.」

99:t_2:13.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you're suspicious, report it to the Leader.」

99:t_2:14.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I intend to. The current Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$, after all.」

99:t_2:15.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't look so grim. I serve as the front-line commander now precisely because I acknowledge him too.」

99:t_2:16.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「To you, Supreme Commander, isn't the $$赤い彗星$$ that man?」

99:t_2:17.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Are you trying to provoke me?」

99:t_2:19.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Never mention that man who betrayed the Spacenoids again.」

99:t_2:21.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It looks like $c is headed for Earth...」

99:t_2:22.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Shall we pursue them in the $$レウルーラ$$?」

99:t_2:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「No... I have no intention of provoking the $$サイデリアル$$ by moving carelessly. We can leave it to the units in charge of that area.」

99:t_2:24.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$, continue your patrol duty from here on.」

99:t_2:25.en:
$$ヒル$$
「Where are you headed, Supreme Commander?」

99:t_2:26.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Back to $$パラオ$$ for now. If $c is going to move, we need to rework our strategy accordingly with the Leader.」

99:t_2:27.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Take the $$レウルーラ$$ back, Captain.」

99:t_2:28.en:
$$ヒル$$
「Understood. We will leave part of the fleet behind, and this ship will return to $$パラオ$$.」

99:t_2:30.en:
$$ハマーン$$
($c... I'll have you move for that purpose...)

99:t_2:34.en: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, Captain's Quarters ～

99:t_2:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes. The current Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is believed to be $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

99:t_2:37.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「After the battle at the Absolute Defense Line, we spent our time mainly in space, investigating $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements.」

99:t_2:38.en:
$$オットー$$
「Separately from the $$地球連邦軍$$?」

99:t_2:39.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes... Using methods the $$連邦軍$$ can't use, too.」

99:t_2:40.en:
$$オットー$$
($$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was originally a private armed organization that fought the whole world, I hear... Missions like that must be second nature to them...)

99:t_2:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As you saw in today's battle, the Supreme Commander of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces is $$ハマーン・カーン$$, but...」

99:t_2:42.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The one holding full authority behind the scenes is believed to be the Leader, $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

99:t_2:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「But why? In $$ネオ・ジオン$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$, $$フロンタル$$ should have been $$ハマーン$$'s subordinate.」

99:t_2:44.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$フロンタル$$ must have had something powerful enough to overturn that.」

99:t_2:45.en:
$$オットー$$
「What on earth is it...」

99:t_2:46.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We were unable to find any firm evidence, but...」

99:t_2:47.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I believe it was most likely a deal with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

99:t_2:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That must be why the colonies are excluded from the Empire's range of activity.」

99:t_2:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「What was the bargaining chip? What did $$フロンタル$$ offer to win over the Empire?」

99:t_2:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Unfortunately, I can't tell that far. But I'm sure even Captain $$オットー$$ can guess the worst answer...」

99:t_2:52.en:
$$オットー$$
「...Helping them rule the Earth... No... At worst, the annihilation of the Earthnoids...」

99:t_2:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In these two months, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has built up its forces and is about to resume full-scale activity.」

99:t_2:55.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ sensed that movement, so you sought to join up with us, I take it?」

99:t_2:58.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「《$$ヴェーダ$$》 has fallen into the hands of the $$サイデリアル$$.」

99:t_2:60.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The reason we were able to keep operating independently these two months was largely the power of $$ヴェーダ$$.」

99:t_2:61.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But now that it has fallen into enemy hands, we have to change the way we fight.」

99:t_2:62.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ was... the linchpin of the command system even for the $$地球連邦軍$$...」

99:t_2:63.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That is why it was probably defended by various means, starting with optical camouflage, but those must have been breached.」

99:t_2:64.en:
$$オットー$$
「Given this, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ resuming activity may be because they knew about it.」

99:t_2:65.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We need to read $$フル・フロンタル$$'s intentions as soon as possible, and depending on the situation, strike $$ネオ・ジオン$$ before the $$新地球皇国$$ does.」

99:t_2:66.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then to $$パラオ$$, which is thought to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current base...」

99:t_2:67.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... That asteroid is now a fortress that has taken the place of $$アクシズ$$. With our current force, we wouldn't even be able to get close.」

99:t_2:68.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I propose that we descend to North America.」

99:t_2:69.en:
$$オットー$$
「The remaining $$連邦軍$$ have gathered on that continent and are locked in a back-and-forth struggle with the Empire, but...」

99:t_2:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That is exactly why $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will likely send troops there too.」

99:t_2:72.en:
$$オットー$$
「Descend to North America」
「Descend to Japan」

99:t_2:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. We will descend to North America as well.」

99:t_2:74.en:
$$オットー$$
「As for Japan, I'm sure $$新日本$$ will hold the front line for us.」

99:t_2:75.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I hear 'he' is in $$新日本$$. I'm sure he will fight it out even if the opponent is the $$新地球皇国$$.」

99:t_2:76.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then this ship will change course for the North American descent.」

99:t_2:77.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Before we fight the Empire, let's gather as much information on $$ネオ・ジオン$$ as we can.」

99:t_2:78.en:
$$オットー$$
(Another battle over $$ラプラスの箱$$, then... What on earth is that thing...)

99:t_2:79.en:
$$オットー$$
(Does it still have the power to change the world, even in a situation like this...?)

99:t_2:80.en:
$$オットー$$
「No... We will descend to Japan. I'm concerned about the situation at the $$ジオフロント$$, and above all, the Empire is reaching out to $$新日本$$.」

99:t_2:81.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we leave it as it is, the Pacific will end up completely under the Empire's control.」

99:t_2:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's leave the investigation of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ to the $$連邦軍$$ in North America.」

99:t_2:83.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Then we will descend to North America to cooperate with the $$連邦軍$$.」

99:t_2:84.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. If any new information comes in, please contact us.」

99:t_2:85.en:
$$オットー$$
(But to think it would be another battle over $$ラプラスの箱$$... What on earth is that thing...)

99:t_2:86.en:
$$オットー$$
(Does it still have the power to change the world, even in a situation like this...?)

99:t_2:90.en: ～ $$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s Private Residence ～
